scope.question: What current primary-source rights evidence applies to three intended commercial uses of each of the seven retained EPA/GHG Protocol artifacts used by the four current M79 calculation profiles?

interpretiveBoundary.statement: This is dated rights evidence and conservative product gating, not legal advice, a license, permission, production approval, or a conclusion that any copyright exception applies.
rules: Public availability, an official government URL, a download, or a retained hash does not establish rights for an intended commercial use.
Publisher purpose language is evidence of intended subject-matter use, not a commercial reproduction, redistribution, or corpus license.
The copyright status of individual facts or numbers does not decide contract, compilation, attribution, trademark, foreign-law, third-party-content, or database-right questions.
A report based on a standard is distinct from reproducing source expression in that report.

Every intended use remains under a Neuvetra product-release hold until the named owner records a source-specific decision. A release hold is not a conclusion that the use is legally prohibited or that a license is required.

officialEvidence.title: EPA Disclaimers
shortQuotes: Commercial use of the documents available from the EPA websites may be protected under the U.S. and Foreign Copyright Laws.
Individual documents on the EPA website may have different copyright conditions, and that will be noted in those documents.
officialEvidence.applicability: Current official EPA policy context. Its opening paragraph says the catalogue does not necessarily apply to a particular work unless EPA expressly incorporates it by reference or hyperlink. No such incorporation or source-specific rights term was found for the five retained EPA artifacts. The page therefore establishes neither source-specific protection/restriction nor permission.

officialEvidence.title: GHG Emission Factors Hub
shortQuotes: designed to provide organizations with a regularly updated and easy-to-use set of default emission factors for organizational greenhouse gas reporting
officialEvidence.applicability: Directly supports that EPA intended the Hub factors for organizational reporting and confirms the 2025 XLSX/PDF publication links. It does not state a commercial, redistribution, or hosted-corpus license.

officialEvidence.title: 17 U.S.C. section 105, 2024 edition
locators: historical and revision notes, scope of prohibition
shortQuotes: Copyright protection under this title is not available for any work of the United States Government
officialEvidence.applicability: Primary statutory text defines the domestic U.S.-government-work rule. The legislative notes distinguish official-duty employee works from contractor or grantee works. The retained EPA artifacts do not establish authorship provenance sufficient for this research record to classify every component as a section 105 work.

officialEvidence.title: Compendium of U.S. Copyright Office Practices, Third Edition, 2021 update
locators: Compendium landing page: governing administrative manual statement
shortQuotes: Individual numbers are not copyrightable and cannot be registered with the U.S. Copyright Office.
A compilation of numbers may be registered if there is a sufficient amount of creativity
officialEvidence.applicability: The Copyright Office identifies the January 28, 2021 update as its governing administrative manual. Chapter 700 distinguishes ideas, procedures, processes, methods, facts and individual numbers from copyrightable expression and sufficiently creative compilation selection, coordination or arrangement. It does not itself decide contract, attribution, trademark, foreign-law, third-party-source or database-right questions.

officialEvidence.title: Greenhouse Gas Protocol Terms of Use
locators: section 3 Our Intellectual Property Rights and Limited License to You
shortQuotes: otherwise use the Services or the GHG Protocol Content for any public or commercial purpose
You must comply with the licenses of all data and datasets on the Website.
officialEvidence.applicability: Current official web-access and online-services terms restrict specified acts involving the Services and GHG Protocol Content. Whether and how those terms apply to the exact retained 2004/2013 PDF bytes, the amendment's pre-existing printed license, individual facts/numbers or independently implemented principles remains unresolved. This evidence is kept separate from the publications' exact notices and is neither a source-specific prohibition finding nor permission.

officialEvidence.applicability: Explains the exact license printed on the February 2013 required-gases amendment. The license limits commercial exercise of the licensed reproduction/distribution rights in the copyrightable work and bars distribution of adaptations, while preserving public-domain elements and uses allowed by legal exceptions or limitations. It does not establish that an individual fact, number or independently expressed process requires a copyright license.
